configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.displayName: Dev (Debug build, full assertions + stats + kernel tracing)
configurePresets.description: Inner-dev-loop preset. -O0 -g, ECO_GC_DEBUG, ECO_KERNEL_DEBUG, GC stats all ON. Slow runtime; fastest iteration on diagnostics.

configurePresets.name: build
configurePresets.description: Default everyday build. -O2 -g -UNDEBUG, asserts ON, GC stats ON, ECO_KERNEL_DEBUG OFF. Hosts the bootstrap chain and the eco-quick fast-iteration target.

configurePresets.name: mac-build
configurePresets.displayName: Mac build (RelWithDebInfo, brew llvm@21, full runtime)
configurePresets.description: Full configure on macOS: runtime, kernels, tests, compiler. LLVM/MLIR from the brew llvm@21 keg; AppleClang + ld64 (no lld). See plans/build-on-mac.md M3.

configurePresets.name: mac-frontend
configurePresets.displayName: Mac front-end only (bootstrap stages 1-5, no native backend)
configurePresets.description: Configures only compiler/ via ECO_FRONTEND_ONLY. Pure Node/Elm bootstrap through Stage 5 (eco-compiler.mlir); no LLVM/MLIR, runtime, kernels or tests. See plans/build-on-mac.md.

configurePresets.name: win-frontend
configurePresets.displayName: Windows front-end only (bootstrap stages 1-5, no native backend)
configurePresets.description: Configures only compiler/ via ECO_FRONTEND_ONLY. Pure Node/Elm bootstrap through Stage 5 — exercises the toolchain.cmake Windows branch + the Elm-compiler /-separator path (build-on-windows item 10b). No LLVM/MLIR, runtime, kernels or tests. clang-cl pinned even for the front-end path so the auto-probe doesn't pick up a stray MinGW install.

configurePresets.name: win-build
configurePresets.displayName: Windows build (clang-cl + lld-link, /MT static CRT, LLVM 21.1.8 via $LLVM_DIR)
configurePresets.description: Full configure on Windows: runtime, kernels, tests, compiler. clang-cl targeting x86_64-pc-windows-msvc + lld-link; CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH expands $LLVM_DIR — set it to the prefix containing the LLVM 21.1.8 install produced by experiments/win-llvm-build before running this preset (no default; CMake's find_package(MLIR REQUIRED) will fail loudly with a list of expected file names if LLVM_DIR is unset). See plans/build-on-windows.md.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Stage B static musl build. -O2 -DNDEBUG, no debug syms, no asserts, GC stats OFF, kernel-debug OFF, --strip-all on the final link.
